notes: Reproduced via dist/cli.js on a `type: commonjs` host: job new, check, friction and tick all exit 2 with the refusal headlined; `job run` (src/cli.ts, the jobRun preflight catch) tests only JobUsageError and exits 1 behind `[flume] job run failed:`. jobRun reaches loadChainModule whenever the baton is hibernating.
